incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT — eval-sentinel triggered: OUTPUT-DRIFT + SAFETY_SPIKE on route /chat-prod using model redwood-4k-v2. regression_score=0.72 (threshold 0.6). Paging on-call: @matt_oncall. PD: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-12345|PD-12345> 

matt_oncall: ack @incident-bot I'm on it, checking dashboards and traces :mag: 

maria_ml: ping. what's the initial symptom? any 5xxs or customer errors? 

matt_oncall: no 5xxs. Metrics show a sudden jump in safety flags and suppressed tokens on the eval harness. rolling avg problem rate went from ~4% to ~22% in the last 10m. starting a quick canary-vs-prod diff. 

sahil_sre: adding SRE to the thread. I'll watch infra (autoscaler, node mem, QPS). Any signs of resource pressure? 

matt_oncall: infra alarms clean so far. Suspect model-level regression after the recent rollout. @deploy-bot any deploy activity for /chat-prod in last hour? 

deploy-bot: Recent rollout: 13:15 UTC — redwood-4k-v2 was rolled to 30% of /chat-prod traffic (rollout id r-9831). More info: <https://console.redwood/rollouts/r-9831|r-9831> 

maria_ml: that matches the timeline. Recommend immediate traffic rollback to redwood-4k-v1 while we triage. Can we cut traffic back to v1 100%? 

matt_oncall: initiating rollback now. Running traffic policy change. Command executed: ```
rbx route update /chat-prod --model redwood-4k-v1 --weight 100 --actor matt_oncall
``` Will monitor metrics and PD. 

pagerduty-bot: PD-12345 ACK by matt_oncall at 13:48 UTC :white_check_mark: Escalations paused. 

sahil_sre: I can confirm the policy change propagated. /chat-prod now at 100% redwood-4k-v1. No cpu/mem OOMs, nodes healthy. 

maria_ml: quick impact estimate: elevated unsafe outputs between ~13:12–13:47 UTC. ~1.2k unique sessions potentially affected, majority internal QA + a small set of paying customers. No PII detected in sampled artifacts. Recommend preserving samples and starting a focused eval diff run. Also recommend postmortem and opt-in customer notices for those with flagged outputs. 

jamie_prod: looping in support. I'll draft an internal blurb and a Q/A for CS to use. Please don't send customer notices until we validate samples. 

matt_oncall: collecting logs and sample diffs now. Uploading artifacts to: /artifacts/pd-12345/samples.tar.gz. Handing off to @maria_ml for root-cause analysis. Not seeing obvious param changes in runtime logs; sampling/temp looks nominal in traces. 

maria_ml: got artifacts. Kicking off the eval harness with differential prompts and safety classifiers. If this is a training/model distribution change we'll need a model rebuild or revert commit. Will update within 2 hours with root-cause hypothesis. 

matt_oncall: updated PD incident with mitigation details and who/what/when. I'll keep the page open until we confirm stable metrics on prod v1 for 30m. Anyone else monitoring? 

jamie_prod: support is standing by. Draft ready to review once we have a confirmed impact list. 

maria_ml: marking as ongoing. Mitigation applied (traffic rollback). ETA to initial findings ~2 hours. Will post follow-up including samples, diffs, and suggested next steps (redeploy, retrain, or cherry-pick revert). 

matt_oncall: thanks all — handoff complete for now. Closing on-call actions: rollback done, artifacts collected, PD acknowledged. Will update thread after triage. :lock:
